description: Header file defining the Telemetry class for a plugin handling JSONRPC communication, including notification handling, report management, and optional user settings notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: Telemetry
classes.description: A plugin class implementing JSONRPC communication and report management, with optional user settings notification support.

classes.name: UserSettingsNotification
classes.description: Notification class for user settings changes, specifically privacy mode updates, within the Telemetry plugin.

methods.name: setReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the report profile status based on provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: logApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event based on provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: NotifyT2PrivacyMode
methods.description: Notifies the plugin of a privacy mode change.
